subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: When a globally installed plugin still has Claw references, should uninstall remain warning-only or require explicit force consent?
rationale: Both behaviors are technically implementable, but the choice determines whether operator control may immediately break dependent Claw agents and affects later status, remove, update, doctor, and recovery contracts.

options.title: Keep Advisory Removal
options.body: Preserve the existing operator-controlled uninstall behavior, but require clear dependency warnings and proven recovery/status behavior.

options.title: Require Explicit Force
options.body: Block referenced plugin removal unless the operator explicitly accepts that dependent Claw agents may break.

options.title: Defer Shared Plugins
options.body: Limit the initial package slice to workspace-local skills until shared dependency ownership and removal policy are approved.

recommendation.title: Keep Advisory Removal
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing operator-controlled uninstall behavior, but require clear dependency warnings and proven recovery/status behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared plugin-management and uninstall services in their recent history are the primary enforcement boundary for this policy.
